newsitem.title: INDIA: RBI dollar buying pushes Indian rupee down.
newsitem.headline: RBI dollar buying pushes Indian rupee down.

text.p: The Indian rupee weakened further in noon trade on Reserve Bank of India (RBI) dollar purchases, dealers said.
Dealers said the rupee fell to 35.79 per dollar after opening at 35.745/755.
They said RBI bought spot dollars up to 35.7850 before noon, having started buying around 35.75 in the morning.
"At the moment it's all RBI," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "There is a little bit of corporate buying but the central bank is dictating the market moves."
"We could see the rupee at 35.82 or so by close today if they (RBI) continue buying," he said.
The dealer said the RBI's earlier purchases seemed to have stopped around 35.78 but picked up again later.
In latest deals, the dollar was quoted 35.79/80 rupees.
